analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, patches and BASE/HEAD source against the canonical index and selected T-041 detail. SandboxAddon.swift:154-173,211-225 adds optional work-disk status and infers compatibility from a disks array; malformed entries are omitted and negative slot totals clamped. Existing bounded command execution remains unchanged (52-65). SandboxEligibility.swift:247-262 adds informational per-disk plan output; 311-319 refactors job-count formatting without changing admission or resource allocation. These changes show no concrete authorization, attestation, encryption, billing or inference-isolation regression.

The external-drive workflow documented in docs/provider/sandboxes.md:62-99 adds a security-relevant contract: APFS and ownership checks, interactive sudo enableOwnership, persistent disk selection, and refusal on unsupported releases. Relevant scope is A-019/TB-013/T-061 (owner-account execution) and A-018/TB-012/T-059 (availability). Integration must examine the changed setup/volume implementation and status consumers: argv-safe sudo invocation, consent behavior under --yes/noninteractive use, volume identity and mount replacement handling, safe handling of returned disk paths, and compatibility refusal before installation. The supplied parser alone does not establish those controls or their absence.

T-041 describes separate encrypted inference-cache storage and detached-media limitations; this batch does not change that cache or establish that sandbox disks contain inference data. Do not transfer cache encryption guarantees to VM disks. Resolve the new peripheral-storage and privilege contracts in integration, including whether TB-013 needs corresponding coverage. Remaining uncertainty concerns this PR's new workflow, not unrelated unchanged dependencies.
